title: Upgrade to v4.1.0: CosmWasm security update and fixes
summary: Upgrades passage-2 to v4.1.0 at height PENDING_HEIGHT. CosmWasm security update: wasmd v0.50.0 -> v0.54.10 and wasmvm v1.5.0 -> v2.2.9, patching CWA-2026-006 (Wasmer Singlepass sandbox escape that can lead to native token minting) and CWA-2026-005; Cosmos SDK v0.50.13 -> v0.50.15 and ibc-go v8.0.0 -> v8.8.0 as required by wasmd (ibc module migration 5 -> 6). Also fixes issues found since v4.0.0: Ledger/Amino-signed CosmWasm transactions accepted again; MsgClaim accepted again (signer annotation); legacy governance proposals (text, x/params parameter change) restored; the duplicate account number of the claim module account is repaired by the upgrade handler; wasm gas register and blocked-multisig ante fixes. No stores added or removed; contract code and state are preserved (tested on v4.0.3 -> v4.1.0 with every contract code stored on passage-2). Validators must stage the new binary together with its libwasmvm library. Release, checksums and instructions: https://github.com/envadiv/Passage3D/releases/tag/v4.1.0 and docs/v4.1.0-upgrade/VALIDATORS.md.
